_comment: Synced from live Tavus objectives graph (manually edited in the Tavus dashboard on 2026-07-29) — flat 3-node graph: generate_prefill_examples -> complete_zine_panels -> wrap_up_session. This REPLACES the old 8-panel-template/50-node structure. scripts/lib/tavus-provisioning.mjs's buildObjectivesGraph() still expands the old template shape and does NOT match this file anymore — do not run setup-tavus.mjs against this file until that script is updated, or it will regenerate the old 50-node graph and overwrite this one live.

data.objective_prompt: If the difficulty is greater than 0, say one brief sentence that you're pulling together a few worked examples, then silently invoke the log_zine_page tool once per panel (source "prefill"), panel_number 1 through the difficulty count, back to back with no spoken explanation in between. If the difficulty is 0, skip this step and say so in one brief sentence before moving on. This setup must finish quickly to preserve session time.

Guide the student through the creation of all 8 panels of the zine study guide. For each panel, follow a strict sequence: 1. Await the student's initial write-up or sketch on the canvas. 2. Test their understanding using a transfer question (a small new problem) rather than asking for a re-explanation. 3. Once understanding is verified as solid, agree on a light-polish version of the student's words and log the page. This objective is complete once all 8 panels have been finalized and logged.
The zine is complete. Give a short recap naming what the student proved and where they fought hardest (e.g., which concepts took multiple attempts), then let them know they can export their zine.
